title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: Service Contract Relief from the Telex Release Fee
content:
A telex release on a `Bills of Lading and Transport Documents` record may be free of charge because of the service contract behind the shipment. This page sets out which contract is looked at and when it relieves the documentation party of the fee.

## Rule

1. **Which contract.** The contract considered is the one whose rates apply to the shipment: the service contract whose reference appears on the booking the document covers. Both the booking and the contract read must be held by the documentation party of the document.
2. **Contract must be active.** Only a contract whose status is active can relieve the fee.
3. **Rank test.** The contract's tier is converted into its rank on the service contract tier ladder. No fee is charged when that rank is equal to or higher than the lowest contract tier rank that the document type accepts for relief.
4. **Zero threshold.** Where the document type's threshold rank is 0, no contract of any tier relieves the fee.
5. **Contracts that never relieve the fee.** A contract other than the one referenced on the booking, a contract whose status is anything but active, and a booking or contract held by a customer other than the documentation party never relieve the fee. A spot booking with no contract reference has no contract that could relieve it.

## Condition, judgement, result

| Contract named on the booking | Contract status | Held by the documentation party | Contract rank reaches the type's threshold (threshold above 0) | Fee relieved? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Active | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Yes | Active | Yes | No | No |
| Yes | Suspended, expired or terminated | Yes | any | No |
| Yes | Active | No | any | No |
| None (spot booking) | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | No |
| Any | any | any | Threshold is 0 | No |

## Hypothetical cases

- The booking references an active contract held by the documentation party, and the rank of that contract's tier is exactly the document type's threshold. The threshold is reached, so no fee is charged.
- The booking references an active contract whose rank falls short of the threshold, while the documentation party also holds a higher-ranked contract on another lane that is not named on this booking. Only the contract referenced on the booking counts, so the fee is charged.
- The contract named on the booking has expired. It relieves nothing, whatever its tier.
